deflection_zh: 這件事一定讓你很難過，我們去找爸爸媽媽聊聊好嗎？

5-6: 告訴孩子：這不是你的錯
說：爸爸媽媽吵架，不代表不愛你
讓孩子知道：可以說出難過，也可以哭
說明：每天照顧你的大人還是會在
7-8: 說明大人的感情問題，不是孩子造成的
不批評另一方，說「每個人都有難處」
說明家庭可能改變，但愛不會改變
問孩子最擔心什麼，一起想想辦法

what_not_to_say: 不要說「都是你害的」或「你不乖」
不要在孩子面前說另一方的壞話
不要要求孩子選擇跟爸爸或媽媽

sources.title: HealthyChildren.org - From the American Academy of Pediatrics

author: claude-haiku

en.deflection: That must feel really hard. Let's go talk with mom and dad together, okay?

5-6: Tell your child: this is not your fault.
Say: when parents argue, it doesn't mean they stop loving you.
Let your child know it's okay to feel sad and to cry.
Explain that the grown-ups who take care of them every day are still there.
7-8: Explain that grown-up relationship problems are not caused by the child.
Don't criticize the other parent; say 'everyone has difficult times'.
Explain that the family may change, but love does not.
Ask what they worry about most, and think of ways to help together.

what_not_to_say: Don't say 'it's all your fault' or 'you were naughty'.
Don't speak badly about the other parent in front of your child.
Don't ask your child to choose between dad and mom.
